name: unmassk-electronics
description: Agent-driven electronics for makers — build, program, and verify real hardware against a physical device, never against hope. Multi-branch: microcontrollers/firmware (ESP32/RP2040/STM32 via PlatformIO, flash + serial-assert gate), Raspberry Pi / Linux SBC (SSH + gpiozero + systemd health checks), and robotics (motors/servos/sensors, sensor-gated behaviour). One rule across all three: never report done until the device confirms it. Toolset installs only when a project is actually an electronics project. Wiring/soldering stays human.
